attributes.title: phase4_policy_probe
attributes.description: CI-only Phase 4 characterization probe. Reads every candidate Runtime Target Policy storage location at a bounded cost and reports the measurements without deciding the policy.

parameters.name: policyPath
parameters.description: Deployment-owned policy Tag path to read, for example [IgnitionMCPPolicy]RuntimeTargetPolicy.

parameters.name: missingPath
parameters.description: Tag path that must not exist, used to record the fail-closed read shape.

parameters.name: writeProbePath
parameters.description: Second Tag inside the policy provider that a handler write is attempted against.

parameters.name: writeProbeValue
parameters.description: Value written by the handler-scope write attempt.

parameters.name: policyLengthPath
parameters.description: Companion Tag holding the policy document's byte length.

parameters.name: oversizePolicyPath
parameters.description: Harness-only Tag holding a document larger than the configured maximum.

parameters.name: oversizeLengthPath
parameters.description: Companion Tag holding the oversize document's byte length.

parameters.name: maxPolicyBytes
parameters.description: Deployment-enforced maximum policy size the gate refuses to read past.
